source_quote: At 15 °C, growth of the cspB cspC double mutant was also strongly impaired comparable to the cspB cspD double mutant ( Figure 1 B), whereas the cspC cspD double mutant showed a slight growth defect.
notes: Vegetative cells plated on LB agar and incubated at 15 °C for 11 days (37 °C plates are the permissive control). Growth of the double mutant was strongly impaired, but the paper reports only colony images (Figure 1B), so response_value is null.
